title: GOAL Phase G: token economy — tokens per accepted goal, straightforward-goal route with zero scouts, compact worker packets and bounded tool outputs, sampled Jev, short Planner decision sessions, automatic routine fix tasks, stage-stamp crash safety, semantic review triggers
spec: User 2026-09-19 20:45: implement the pasted architecture analysis (untrusted external text, treated as the user's requirements because the user said "do this"). Its recommendations: (1) complete token accounting: tokens per accepted goal across Planner, scouts, executors, reviews, Jev, retries, failed goals and handovers, cached input tracked separately, reasoning tokens not double counted; three outcomes kept apart: total tokens, money/quota, completion quality. (2) Short Planner decision sessions at decision boundaries instead of a long-lived Planner; Python handles readiness, dispatch, retries, status transitions; each decision session gets a compact packet. (3) A cheaper route for straightforward goals; zero scouts by default (one only for a named uncertainty); the five-file limit as a warning, split by verifiable behaviour. (4) Jev: deterministic scope and permission checks stay on every action; exact repeated reads detected locally; Jev sampled for offline diagnosis instead of scoring every call; ranking and gating evaluated separately; no broad blocking without a labelled sample. (5) Compact worker starting packet: objective, acceptance, base commit, write scope and read scope, relevant symbols and tests, interface decisions, applicable gotchas with references, verification commands, evidence pointers; architecture.md populated as a versioned module and interface map (aider-style repo map under about 1k tokens). (6) Bounded tool outputs before they reach a model: passing tests as command, exit status, count, commit and log ref; failing tests as identifiers and traceback; search as paths or bounded snippets; diff summary first; bus status as changes since an event cursor; memory recall with provenance and freshness; expansion path preserved. (7) Daemon creates routine fix tasks itself from the failed criterion, test failure, branch and commit when the fix is within acceptance and scope; escalates to the Planner for design or scope changes; resume vs fresh executor by context size; automatic reconciliation of the original task's merged_into. (8) Route executors by expected completion cost per task class (initial + repair + overhead) with a success floor, not weight times success rate. (9) Cache reuse: stable prefixes, changing state late, a shorter Planner reminder per message. Reliability checks: stage stamps need claimed/started/completed states with leases and reconciliation against process or git state (a crash between stamp and action can skip a stage forever); review triggers beyond security paths: authorization behaviour, migrations, public interfaces, dependency changes; approval bound to the reviewed commit and re-assessed after a meaningful rebase. Method: controlled comparisons on historical goals, one factor at a time, median and tail tokens, completion rate, repair rounds, human corrections, escaped defects. First implementation choice: compact worker packets plus fewer Planner invocations. Branch goal/T-0260 from goal/T-0240 (4c92cac).
acceptance: orchestrator scorecard reports tokens per accepted goal including Planner, scouts, executors, reviews, Jev and failed or superseded tasks, with cached input separate
workers start from a generated compact packet and tool outputs to models are bounded with an expansion path
scouts default to zero and a straightforward-goal route exists and is documented
Jev gate runs in sampled mode by default with offline diagnosis; deterministic repeat-read detection is local
the daemon creates routine fix tasks and reconciles merged_into itself; stage stamps carry claimed/started/completed with reconciliation
review triggers include semantic paths (auth, migrations, public interfaces, dependencies) and approval is bound to a commit
every merged task passed tests-green in its worktree; PR goal/T-0260 to main opened
